Subtracting 359 days from 1243-01-19:  
1243 is not a leap year (1243 ÷ 4 = 310.75).  
359 days before Jan 19, 1243: go back 19 days → 1242-12-31, then back 340 more days → 340 − 31 (Dec) − 30 (Nov) − 31 (Oct) − 30 (Sep) − 31 (Aug) − 31 (Jul) − 30 (Jun) − 31 (May) − 30 (Apr) − 31 (Mar) = 14 days left into February.  
February 1242 had 28 days (1242 ÷ 4 = 310.5, not leap), so 14 days before March 1 → Feb 15, 1242.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1242-02-15
